subject: Mid-month payment check + VAT split — please confirm remittance
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morales <am@greenforge.io>, Finance AP <ap@greenforge.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-month payment check + VAT split — please confirm remittance

Hi Alex / GreenForge AP,

Quick check-in on invoice RF-INV-2026-143 (due 2026-06-20). Our billing team shows this as pending and wanted to confirm your planned remittance path so we can reconcile on our side:

- Preferred route: ACH to Redwood US operating account
- Alternate: wire (we can provide swift/IBAN details)
- Tax/VAT: you previously mentioned the payment will be split across two legal entities — can you confirm the split amounts and whether you need an updated VAT breakdown from our side?

If ACH, please reply with the payment date and remittance reference. If wire, tell us the expected send date and we’ll share the beneficiary instructions.

Irene — can you hold the invoice in pending status until we get confirmation?

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RF-INV-2026-143.pdf (invoice)

From: Alex Morales <am@greenforge.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@greenforge.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-month payment check + VAT split — please confirm remittance

Hi Grace — apologies for the delay. We will be initiating payment this week. Quick notes: 

1) We’ll split the payment across GreenForge US and GreenForge EU (our AP policy requires entity-level posting). Tentative split: 70% (US) / 30% (EU). We’ll confirm exact cents when AP issues the payment.

2) Route: prefer ACH for the US portion; wire for the EU portion (GBP/EUR) to avoid cross-border ACH failures.

3) VAT: the EU team needs a VAT breakdown line-by-line for the 30% portion or a VAT-exempt certificate if Redwood can provide one. Can you supply either?

We expect funds to be sent by EOD Thu, 2026-06-18. I’ll loop our AP contact if you want the remittance to go to a different mailbox.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Morales
Head of Finance Operations
GreenForge Analytics

Attachments:

Best,
